data.name: Jamiaah
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Jamiaah symbolizes a large gathering or assembly of people. It is derived from the Arabic root 'jama'a' which means 'to gather' or 'to assemble'. This name is often given to girls in the hope that they will bring people together and foster unity and solidarity.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unity and togetherness in the Muslim community.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Jamiaah resonates with the number 2, which is associated with harmony, balance, and partnership. Individuals with this name are often natural peacemakers and strive for unity in their personal and professional relationships.

in_arabic.name: جامعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جامعة مشتق من الجماعة والجمع في اللغة العربية، ويشير إلى توحيد الناس أو الأشياء المختلفة في مكان واحد. وردت الكلمة في القرآن الكريم بمعنى الجمع بين الأشياء، مما يعكس الأهمية الكبيرة للتوحيد والاجتماع في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: جامعہ
in_urdu.meaning: جامعہ کا مطلب ہے اکٹھا کرنا،รวม کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جامعہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جو 'جماعة' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اکٹھا کرنا یا جمع کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقليد میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر علم اور تعلیم کے حصول میں۔

in_hindi.name: जामिया
in_hindi.meaning: जामिया का अर्थ है एकत्र करना, सम्मिलित करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: जामिया नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है, जहां यह 'जमअ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है एकत्र करना या सम्मिलित करना। इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में विशेष रूप से शिक्षा और ज्ञान के संदर्भ में किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جامعه
in_pashto.meaning: جامعه د ټولوالي راټولولو مانا ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د جامعه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوي، چې د ټولولو يا راټولولو مانا لري. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې د پوهې او زده کړې په ترلاس کې کارول کيږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jamiaah reflects the importance of community and camaraderie in Islamic culture. It implies that the individual is just a tiny piece of a larger whole, and that the strength and unity of this collective gathering is essential to society. Additionally, it suggests the bringing together of minds and hearts through shared knowledge, traditions, and goals.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jamiaah holds spiritual significance as well, as it can be seen as a reminder of the unity of all believers in the faith of Islam. All Muslims worldwide are part of this global Jamiaah or collective community. Additionally, the name symbolizes the gathering of seekers of knowledge, as in the famous Islamic university Al-Jamia al-Islamia or Al-Azhar University. This pursuit of knowledge is considered a key aspect of spiritual growth and development in Islam.
